criteria.text: IfRange.check(etag, last_modified) returns True for a strong ETag equal to etag or a date equal to last_modified, False otherwise (empty IfRange, differing values, etag None).

Range.make_content_range clamps a too-large stop or suffix length to the complete length, uses only the first of several ranges, returns None when unsatisfiable, and does so without importing http.is_byte_range_valid; Range.from_header and ContentRange.from_header reject invalid values.
ETagSet.from_header discards invalid unquoted values while keeping valid quoted and weak tags.

apply_conditions evaluates If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since in RFC 9110 order, for all request methods; failed If-Match/If-Unmodified-Since (and If-None-Match on non-GET/HEAD) raise PreconditionFailed.
A satisfied If-None-Match or If-Modified-Since on GET/HEAD turns the response into 304 with entity headers removed; on other methods it raises PreconditionFailed (412).
A star ETag in If-Match/If-None-Match is evaluated by the exists argument: If-Match * fails when exists=False; If-None-Match * fails/304 when exists=True and passes when exists=False.
apply_range with a satisfiable bytes Range produces 206, sliced data, correct Content-Length and Content-Range; only the first range is used; too-large stop/suffix is clamped to complete length.
apply_range raises RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable for an unsatisfiable range; non-bytes units are ignored; If-Range not matching (via IfRange.check) skips range handling and leaves a 200.
Response.make_conditional, http.is_resource_modified and http.is_byte_range_valid emit DeprecationWarning, make_conditional still produces the same 304/206 results via apply_conditions/apply_range.

send_file with a file-like object detects name (from .name), size and mtime when possible, calls seek(0) so an already-read file or range request reports correct Content-Length/Content-Range, and defaults mimetype to application/octet-stream without raising when no download_name is given.
send_file ETag no longer contains a hash of the path (depends only on mtime and size) and conditional/range behaviour uses apply_conditions/apply_range.
SharedDataMiddleware serves files via send_file, supports 304 and range requests, and does not set Cache-Control max-age by default (cache_timeout default None).
Passing cache or fallback_mimetype to SharedDataMiddleware is still accepted but emits a DeprecationWarning.

docs/quickstart.rst documents apply_conditions and apply_range instead of make_conditional, and CHANGES.rst has an entry describing the new methods, deprecations and send_file/SharedDataMiddleware changes.

intents.rationale: No apply_conditions exists; only make_conditional handles GET/HEAD via is_resource_modified.
Range handling lives in private _process_range_request tied to make_conditional; no public apply_range.
make_conditional and the http helpers are not deprecated yet.
make_content_range delegates to a private helper using is_byte_range_valid and does not clamp; from_header validation must be self-contained.

intents.rationale: ETagSet.from_header currently only matches quoted tags via regex; unquoted values must be explicitly discarded and verified.
send_file uses make_conditional, hashes path into ETag, raises TypeError without a name, and does not seek.
The middleware builds its own responses, defaults cache_timeout to 12h and exposes cache/fallback_mimetype.
Quickstart only mentions make_conditional; changelog needs an entry.
Tests for the new methods are missing and existing tests assert old behaviour.

summary: Add the new capabilities first (datastructures, then Response.apply_conditions/apply_range), migrate send_file and then SharedDataMiddleware onto them, and only then deprecate make_conditional, is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid (so no internal caller emits the warnings). Docs and changelog come last. Datastructures stop importing is_byte_range_valid in the first task so the later deprecation is safe.

tasks.summary: Add IfRange.check, make Range/ContentRange parsing and make_content_range self-validating with clamping and first-range use (no longer importing is_byte_range_valid), and make ETagSet.from_header discard invalid unquoted values. Add tests.

Add Response.apply_conditions and Response.apply_range in wrappers/response.py (make_conditional left untouched for now) with new tests for headers, methods, star ETag, 304 vs 412, and range slicing/clamping/unsatisfiable.

Refactor send_file to use apply_conditions/apply_range, detect name/size/mtime from file-like objects, seek(0), drop path hash from the ETag, and default to application/octet-stream. Update send_file tests.
Serve SharedDataMiddleware files through send_file, drop the default cache_timeout, and deprecate the cache and fallback_mimetype parameters. Update middleware tests.

Deprecate Response.make_conditional (reimplemented via apply_conditions/apply_range), http.is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid; move or remove their old tests and migrate remaining make_conditional uses in tests to expect the warning.
Document apply_conditions/apply_range in the quickstart and add a changelog entry.
